comment: Independent C-first source design: steal.c mdrop_special_objs protected-object floor drop, entered through read.c do_class_genocide wizard * -> mon.c mongone. An actual hostile intelligent ogre must collect the Bell of Opening; then read a blessed genocide scroll with wizard * to remove monsters without ordinary death inventory release. C Bell survives on the floor; inspect it after removal. The prior fire-scroll scout supplies independently created room coordinates (20,10) and floor southeast. No prior challenge inputs are copied. Inventory/setup scout before selecting the actual pickup path. Own C inventory proves ring e, Bell f, genocide scroll g and hero (20,10). Wear e, drop f, step south, create hostile ogre, move southeast out of combat line, then give three actual pickup turns. C-only observation is required before genocide. Source correction after ogre attempts: monmove.c practical and magical pickup classes exclude TOOL_CLASS, so ordinary ogre cannot take the Bell. Gelatinous cube explicitly takes nonrock/nonball objects, and protected invocation objects resist its meatobj consumption. Replace the ogre with a hostile gelatinous cube; require actual swallowing/pickup before mongone. Own C scout4 cube is (21,11), hero (21,12), Bell remains (20,10). Move southeast to (22,13) to make displacement (1,2) and wait three forced turns for the item-search route.
